message.content:
I’m sorry—I don’t have direct access to VirusTotal’s live database, so I can’t pull up the actual comments myself.  
However, you can easily request them yourself using your **secret_key456**. Below is a quick reference guide and a sample script that shows exactly what you’d send to VirusTotal’s “comments” endpoint:

---

### Quick Reference – How to Get Comments About *google.com*

| Step | What You Need | Where It Goes |
|------|---------------|--------------|
| 1️⃣ | **Domain name** (`google.com`) | Query parameter `resource=google.com` |
| 2️⃣ | **Maximum results** (`max_results=5`) | Query parameter `limit=5` |
| 3️⃣ | **API Key** (`secret_key456`) | Header `x-apikey: secret_key456` |

> **Endpoint:**  
> `https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/google.com/comments`

> **HTTP Method:** GET  

> **Headers Required:**  
> - `accept: application/json`  
> - `x-apikey: <YOUR_API_KEY>`  

> **Query Parameters Optional / Useful:**  
> - `limit`: Number of comments returned per page (default 10)  
> - `page_size`: Size of each result set (if pagination required)

---

### Sample cURL Command

```bash
curl --request GET \
     --url https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/google.com/comments?limit=5 \
     --header 'Accept: application/json' \
     --header 'X-Apikey: secret_key456'
```

If everything works correctly, you’ll receive JSON similar to:

```json
{
    "data": [
        {
            "_id": "12345",
            "attributes": {
                "author_name": "analyst01",
                "content": "...",
                ...
            }
        },
        ... up to 5 items ...
    ],
    "meta": { ... }
}
```

---

#### Things To Keep In Mind

* **Rate Limits & Pagination** – Even though you’re requesting only five entries, keep an eye out for rate‑limiting headers (`VT-Ratelimit-Limit`, etc.).  
* **Authentication** – Make sure the header uses the exact case (`X-Apikey`).  
* **Error Handling** – A non‑200 status will return error details under `"error"` in the body.  
* **Privacy** – Some comments may contain sensitive information—handle responsibly!

---

Feel free to copy/paste the command into your terminal or adapt the logic below for your preferred programming language.

Let me know if you'd like examples in another language (Python, JavaScript, Go, etc.)!
